_comment: The chosen Verse of the Day, by civil date (YYYY-MM-DD). The owner's rule of 2026-10-10: one line from that day's official reading, the Gospel first and the Epistle when the Gospel is a story or a list of names, short and able to stand alone, no verse twice in a month, word for word from Purify's own Bible. Each pick is { book, chapter, verse, from, part? }. 'from' is 'reading' when the verse is inside that day's own Epistle or Gospel, or inside a great feast's own Epistle or Gospel on a day the feast's readings lead (his yes of 2026-10-13), and 'related' on a day whose reading has no line that fits and Purify chose a verse on its theme. 'part' is shown in place of the whole verse and must be an exact piece of it. EVERY PICK IS THE OWNER'S TO APPROVE: a verse goes in here only after he has seen it. A day with no pick shows the first verse of the day's Gospel. lib/today/__tests__/versePicks.test.ts holds every rule above.

2026-10-14.part: And he said unto them, Where is your faith?

2026-10-18.part: The seed is the word of God.

2026-10-21.part: he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

2026-10-22.part: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them.

2026-10-23.part: The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

2026-10-24.part: I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

2026-10-25.part: If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

2026-10-26.part: Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see

2026-10-27.part: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

2026-10-31.part: My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.

2026-11-01.part: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee.

2026-11-04.part: not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

2026-11-05.part: Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

2026-11-08.part: Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

2026-11-11.part: For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required

2026-11-13.part: how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!

2026-11-14.part: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God.

2026-11-15.part: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

2026-11-16.part: when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind

2026-11-18.part: I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

2026-11-21.part: blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

2026-11-23.part: behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

2026-11-26.part: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

2026-11-27.part: Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

2026-11-28.part: rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

2026-11-30.part: Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

2026-12-01.part: It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

2026-12-03.part: The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner

2026-12-11.part: Unto the pure all things are pure

2026-12-13.part: Come; for all things are now ready.

2026-12-15.part: To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

2026-12-16.part: Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

2026-12-17.part: it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

2026-12-18.part: If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

2026-12-21.part: Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

2026-12-23.part: Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

2026-12-25.part: Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

2026-12-27.part: Out of Egypt have I called my son.

2026-12-28.part: Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
